question:
Simplify the following :

 {cos X -sqrt{3} sin Xover 2}
solution:
Given:

 {cos X -sqrt{3} sin Xover 2}

Concept used:

cos(x + y) = cos x × cos y - sin x × sin y

π = 180°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fc2a77f638a89accf21851b8261342f31a55f78c75cfccb097a2b4c3334d9d4.png] 

Calculation:

 {cos X -sqrt{3} sin Xover 2}

⇒ frac {1}{2} × cos X - frac {sqrt3}{2} × sin X

⇒ cos 60^circ × cos X - sin 60^circ× sin X

⇒ cos(60° + X)

⇒ Cos ( { π{} over 3} + X)

∴ The simplified value is Cos ( { π{} over 3} + X).
